key.gomacraft_utility.ae_quick_craft: AE: take or craft the hovered EMI item
gomacraft_utility.ae_quick_craft.unavail: %s is not in the network and has no pattern
gomacraft_utility.ae_quick_craft.not_an_: %s cannot be moved to your inventory and has no pattern
gomacraft_utility.ae_grid_craft.timeout: Filled the crafting grid, but %s did not appear (the materials stay in the grid)
key.gomacraft_utility.ae_craft_amount: AE: craft the hovered EMI item (choose the amount)
gomacraft_utility.settings.emi_ae_quick_: When Alt + click crafts, start without the crafting plan screen.
gomacraft_utility.settings.ae2_search_hi: Entries shown when the EMI search box is empty. The AE2 terminal and compasses show one entry and expand on hover.
Entries shown when expanded. The EMI search box also uses it while typing. Scroll for older ones.
Entries kept in the history. Favorites are not counted.
gomacraft_utility.settings.title: gomacraft utility settings
gomacraft_utility.settings.undo.tooltip: Discard the changes made since opening.
gomacraft_utility.settings.reset.tooltip: Reset the shown items to their defaults.
gomacraft_utility.settings.restart: These take effect after restarting the game
gomacraft_utility.settings.unavailable: Unavailable: a required mod is missing or its version does not match.
gomacraft_utility.settings.screenshot_sh: Where "Post to Discord" sends a screenshot.
Hold this key while pressing "Post to Discord" to choose the channel.
gomacraft_utility.feature.ae2_english_se: AE2 terminal search also matches English names.
gomacraft_utility.feature.ae2_search_key: Press F to insert the hovered item's name into the search box (terminal items go to EMI; Alt + F for @modid). Hover an unfocused AE2 or EMI search box and press F to copy the query to the other.
gomacraft_utility.feature.ae2_search_his: Shows the search history left of the AE2 terminal search box.
gomacraft_utility.feature.ae2_search_syn: Double-click the AE2 terminal search box to flip EMI search sync for now. While flipped, the search box has a blue outline.
gomacraft_utility.feature.ae2_tooltip_se: Makes AE2 terminal tooltip search ($) lighter.
gomacraft_utility.feature.naturescompass: Nature's Compass search also matches English and mod names, and filters by prefixes (@ # ~).
gomacraft_utility.settings.naturescompas:
@source  #tag  ~dimension
Combine with spaces (e.g. #forest ~overworld). Type names without spaces (e.g. @biomesoplenty).
gomacraft_utility.settings.explorerscomp:
@source  %group  ~dimension
Combine with spaces (e.g. %village ~overworld). Type names without spaces (e.g. @yungsbetterdungeons).
gomacraft_utility.feature.compass_search: Shows the search history next to the Nature's / Explorer's Compass search box.
gomacraft_utility.feature.explorerscompa: Explorer's Compass search also matches English and mod names, and filters by prefixes (@ % ~).
Translates hard-coded English in RFTools-family and XNet screens.
gomacraft_utility.feature.emi_ae_stock.t: Shows AE network stock counts and "+" for craftable items in EMI.
gomacraft_utility.feature.emi_ae_craft_c: Shows the EMI list on the AE2 crafting plan screen too.
gomacraft_utility.feature.emi_ae_quick_c: Middle-click an EMI item to craft a chosen amount, or Alt + click to take or craft it.
gomacraft_utility.feature.emi_ae_grid_cr: Crafts pattern-less items with the crafting terminal grid.
gomacraft_utility.feature.ae_stock_query: Shows stock counts of the network your wireless terminal reaches, even with the terminal closed.
gomacraft_utility.feature.ttf_glyph_lock: Prevents races while loading TTF fonts.
gomacraft_utility.feature.ae2_repo_sort_: Makes sorting the AE2 terminal list lighter.
gomacraft_utility.feature.ae2_repo_updat: Re-sorts the terminal list once per batch of updates.
gomacraft_utility.feature.screenshot_sha: Adds a button to post screenshots to Discord in the chat.
key.gomacraft_utility.ae2_fill_search: Send hovered item to AE2 terminal search
gomacraft_utility.screenshot.button.hove: Post this screenshot to Discord under your name. Hold %s to choose the channel.
gomacraft_utility.screenshot.expired: This screenshot can no longer be posted.
gomacraft_utility.screenshot.stopped: Posting screenshots is turned off in the settings.
gomacraft_utility.screenshot.busy: Another screenshot is still being sent. Try again shortly.
gomacraft_utility.screenshot.unavailable: This server does not accept screenshots.
gomacraft_utility.screenshot.unreadable: Could not read the screenshot, or it is too large to send.
gomacraft_utility.screenshot.result.acce: The server received the screenshot. It will appear on Discord shortly.
gomacraft_utility.screenshot.result.off: This server does not accept screenshots.
gomacraft_utility.screenshot.result.busy: The server is receiving other screenshots. Try again shortly.
gomacraft_utility.screenshot.result.cool: Wait a little before posting the next screenshot.
gomacraft_utility.screenshot.result.too_: The screenshot is too large to post.
gomacraft_utility.screenshot.result.bad_: The server could not read the screenshot.
gomacraft_utility.screenshot.result.spoo: Too many screenshots are waiting to be posted. Try again later.
gomacraft_utility.screenshot.result.brok: The screenshot was not received completely. Wait a moment and try again.
gomacraft_utility.screenshot.result.erro: The server could not save the screenshot.
key.gomacraft_utility.ae2_copy_emi_searc: Copy EMI search to AE2 terminal search
gomacraft_utility.settings.emi_ae_quick_: Alt + click an EMI item to take it (or craft it if missing). Alt + Shift + click crafts a stack.
gomacraft_utility.feature.emi_search_his: Shows the search history left of the EMI search box. It is shared with the AE2 terminal.
gomacraft_utility.feature.chat_image_vie: Hover over a Discord image link in chat to preview it, or click to view it in-game.
gomacraft_utility.feature.chat_link.tool: Makes http/https URLs in chat clickable.
gomacraft_utility.chat_image.title: Image viewer
gomacraft_utility.chat_image.too_large: This image is too large to show.
